title: THE FREQUENCY BENEATH · A request
venue: private · after a paperback found in the library's return cart · Box 26
logline: The steady trace from every earlier page, alone on graph paper, and for the first time it changes: a single slow rise and fall in the middle of the week, like a breath. He draws it three times to be sure of the shape. The book's last chapter called it a request. He doesn't letter that either. He draws the breath.

panels.composition: Graph paper with the flat steady trace running across it and, in the middle, one slow rise and fall like a single breath; the same shape drawn again twice smaller below it, as if checked.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a page of graph paper with a flat steady hand-drawn trace across it that rises and falls once in the middle like a single breath, the same shape drawn twice more smaller beneath as if checked, no words legible
image.notes: Vol 7: the substrate becoming unstable; Frasier's read of it as a request. Drawn three times to be sure.
